verdict.rationale: A tax authority's online service could reasonably publish system-to-system channels such as transmitter programs or batch filing partners, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only lists user-facing portal features, including login, payments, forms, and an e-invoicing reform landing page. None of it documents a machine channel, system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs, or a published enrollment path.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
